title: Cartesian comparison of the root-cover normalizations
statement: Under the supplied coefficient localization, DVR uniformizer and cartesian generic-cover hypotheses of lem-sbc-root-normalization-localization-comparison, the normalization of the model cover has a morphism c to the original normalization, making a cartesian square with the two normalization structure maps and the explicit Spec of AdjoinRoot.map. The model qcqs instances are supplied. No normalization point, contraction equality, finite normalization assumption, or root-germ assertion is required.

source.place: Tag 0307 (lemma-integral-closure-localize); affine normalization and localization of the root chart

proof.text: Use the proved root_cover_generic_pullback to construct m and its cartesian square before normalization. It uses only the coefficient formula, the generic principal open of the DVR, and hbranch and hT.

Transport hrootloc from F.map to the displayed root polynomial by equality elimination. Give A0 the AdjoinRoot.map algebra structure, use localization flatness, and transport the localization to global sections via both GammaSpecIso ring equivalences. Apply the proved affine-localization normalization comparison to a and beta. The original a is qcqs from finite p and the principal open inclusion.

The cartesian square identifies a0 with pullback.snd a beta. The universal property normalizationDesc constructs mutually inverse isomorphisms of their relative normalizations over Spec A0, with inverseness proved by normalization.hom_ext. Compose this isomorphism with the canonical normalizationPullback isomorphism and the first pullback projection. Its second-projection equation proves the desired cartesian square by IsPullback.of_iso_pullback.

theorem root_cover_normalization_cartesian
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (H B : CommRingCat.{u}) [Algebra H B] (g : H)
    [(Ideal.span {g}).IsPrime] [IsLocalization.AtPrime B (Ideal.span {g})]
    [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (hpi : Irreducible (algebraMap H B g))
    (ψ : Spec H ⟶ L)
    (k : Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B)) ⟶ U)
    (hk : k ≫ i = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ)
    (hbranch : IsPullback k (𝟙 _) i
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H B)) ≫ ψ))
    (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of (FractionRing B))))
    (ρ : T.P ⟶ W.P) (hT : IsPullback ρ T.π W.π k)
    (hrootloc :
      let F := (Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g
      let F0 := F.map (algebraMap H B)
      let γ := AdjoinRoot.map (algebraMap H B) F F0 dvd_rfl
      let := γ.toAlgebra
      IsLocalization ((Ideal.span {g}).primeCompl.map (AdjoinRoot.of F)) (AdjoinRoot F0)) :
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ∀ (hN : IsLocallyNoetherian N),
    let := hN
    let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ ψ)
    ∀ (hp : IsFinite p),
    let := hp
    let a := p ≫ V.ι
    Etale p →
    let pi := algebraMap H B g
    let A0 := AdjoinRoot
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi)
    let q0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B A0))
    let j0 := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap B (FractionRing B)))
    let a0 := pullback.snd (T.π ≫ j0) q0
    let γ := AdjoinRoot.map (algebraMap H B)
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
      ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial B) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C pi) (by simp [pi])
    ∀ (hqc : QuasiCompact a0) (hqs : QuasiSeparated a0),
      letI := hqc
      letI := hqs
      ∃ c : a0.normalization ⟶ a.normalization,
        IsPullback c a0.fromNormalization a.fromNormalization
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom γ))
